instruction: A grand plaza built around a massive warp gate: a towering metal ring with a swirling energy membrane, concentric power pylons arcing electricity, embarkation ramps with waiting transit pods, holographic destination boards, banner-like light columns, travelers' luggage crates, and the portal surface rippling with slow spiral waves that cast shifting light across the plaza.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Warp Gate Plaza. A grand plaza built around a massive warp gate: a towering metal ring with a swirling energy membrane, concentric power pylons arcing electricity, embarkation ramps with waiting transit pods, holographic destination boards, banner-like light columns, travelers' luggage crates, and the portal surface rippling with slow spiral waves that cast shifting light across the plaza. Style: monumental sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
